title: Uwell Viscore Pro+ Cherry Cola Prefilled Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Cherry Cola Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod captures the unmistakable taste of a classic soda. Sweet, tangy Cherry blends with fizzy Cola notes for a lively flavour that’s instantly recognisable and easy to enjoy all day. Each pack contains one 2ml Prefilled Pod preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and one 10ml Refill Pod that automatically tops up the pod as you vape. Together, they provide long-lasting use with up to 20,000 puffs depending on your style. Fitted with a 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod ensures smooth vapour and clear, consistent flavour throughout. Designed exclusively for the Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill into place and you’re ready to go.
